   "description": "The system must count and track deleted records, including item and patron records, by location and by system."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C089",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "Patron Characteristic Filtering",
   "description": "Queries and reports must be limitable or groupable by patron age range, zip code, county of residence, home branch, patron type, and preferred language."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C090",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "Inactive Patron Reporting",
   "description": "The system should generate a configurable report of patrons with no circulation or electronic activity during the previous configurable number of days, filterable or organized by system, home library, county, and similar organizational scope."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C091",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "Transaction History Retention",
   "description": "The system must retain detailed transaction history for a configurable number of days and retain monthly and annual aggregate information indefinitely."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C092",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "Transaction Grouping",
   "description": "The system must group transactions by hour, terminal, branch, and system and support querying all transactions or transaction types, including check-ins, check-outs, fines collected, and patron registrations."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C093",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "Check-In Type Counts",
   "description": "The system must count check-ins both individually and cumulatively by book drop, terminal, and user or self-service source."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C094",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "Check-Out Type Counts",
   "description": "The system must count check-outs both individually and cumulatively by staff check-out, self check-out, staff renewal, self-checkout renewal, online renewal, and OPAC renewal."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C095",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "Hold Placement Counts",
   "description": "The system must count all hold requests and record how each hold was placed, including at a staff desk, at a public computer inside the library, or remotely."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C096",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "Transaction Summary Reports",
   "description": "The system must generate transaction reports for holds placed, holds filled, and check-outs per patron, library, selected group of libraries, system, or county; display check-outs and placed holds per patron; and subtotal holds by types such as active, frozen, and frozen-until."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C097",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "Collection Value Reporting",
   "description": "The system must report item values, based on item-record data, for the entire collection or a portion of it, including items selected by status, format, collection, or other report criteria."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C098",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "Accounting Audit Compliance",
   "description": "All reports and archived data must comply with standard accounting practice and state, county, and municipal auditing requirements."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C099",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "Patron Financial Records",
   "description": "The system must attach fines, charges, waivers, and ecommerce transactions to patron and item records, track fines waived and payments made per library, support easy financial-information updates, and allow queries such as patron accounts with balances above a specified dollar threshold."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C100",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "Financial Report Suite",
   "description": "The system must provide reports of patron account balances by patron, home library, and system; fines and charges by time period and charge type; fines waived by time period and branch; and payments by time period and payment method, including staff desk, self-check station, and OPAC."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C101",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "Payment Audit Ledger",
   "description": "The system must maintain a ledger of patron payments identifying the charges to which payments were applied, to support reconciliation."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C102",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "Circulation Report Catalogue",
   "description": "The system must support circulation reports for check-in count; checkout count; items overdue by a specified number of days with daily, shelf-reading, and patron-contact information; circulation by circulation modifier, category, Dewey classification, shelving location, MARC data, patron county, patron home library, and age demographic; renewals; non-cataloged circulation; total circulation including checkouts, renewals, and non-cataloged circulation; and merged cataloged and non-cataloged circulation."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C103",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "Item Report Catalogue",
   "description": "The system must support item reports for items added, deleted, edited, counted, currently checked out, overdue beyond a specified number of days, marked long overdue, above or below a total-use threshold, created within a date range, missing, in transit by sending and destination libraries, claimed returned, long overdue, containing specified bibliographic text, and items to be converted; reports must also cover fines-stopped reasons, last copies deleted by a library system, weeding data with last-circulation date and circulation count, collection age by call number or shelving location, collection price value by call number or shelving location, and items with specified total use."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C104",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "Bibliographic Report Catalogue",
   "description": "The system must support reports for bibliographic-record counts, edited-record counts, records added by user and library, records with no attached volumes, and records missing specified MARC fields."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C105",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "Patron Report Catalogue",
   "description": "The system must support reports for patron counts; patrons added by month; new patrons by demographic category; patrons by age, county, home library, profile group, survey answer, expiration date, inactive status, note wording, and barred status; survey-answer patron lists; voter survey responses by county and week; voter-registration survey response counts by week; and staff accounts showing last password change and account expiration."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C106",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "Hold Report Catalogue",
   "description": "The system must support reports for hold purchase alerts; items sent or received for holds; IntraPINES loans for all systems, facilities, systems, and facilities; unfilled holds; annual hold counts; and stale holds waiting on hold shelves beyond the permitted pickup period."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C107",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "In-House Use Reports",
   "description": "The system must support reports for non-cataloged in-house use counts by month and cataloged in-house use counts."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C108",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "Transit Report Catalogue",
   "description": "The system must support reports for items in transit to a destination library and items in transit by sending library."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C109",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "Bills Report Catalogue",
   "description": "The system must support reports for bills currently owed by patrons, detailed payments received, detailed forgive/work/goods payments received, detailed voids, and aged debt."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C110",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "Canned Report Interface",
   "description": "The system must provide a canned-report interface for generic reports that individuals can run immediately or on a recurring schedule."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C111",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "On-Demand Report Interface",
   "description": "The system must provide an on-demand report interface for preset maintenance, collection-development, and similar reports whose selection criteria and display options can be edited before execution."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C112",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "Open Template Reporting",
   "description": "The system must provide open-template reporting with circulation, item, patron, bill, and bibliographic attributes available for both filtering and display."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C113",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "Scheduled Report Access",
   "description": "The quick-access reporting interface must allow users to view descriptions by hovering over canned report or template titles, select portions of data, and schedule reports ASAP, hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C114",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "Report Export Formats",
   "description": "Reports must be exportable in Excel, HTML, and CSV formats."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C115",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "Report Email Delivery",
   "description": "The system must allow users to enter email addresses for report delivery and should provide an address book for regularly used addresses."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C116",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "Recurring Report Editing",
   "description": "Users must be able to edit recurring reports by adding or removing report selections and changing their email addresses."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C117",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "Comparative Report Columns",
   "description": "The system must support report outputs with comparative columns such as last month's circulation, the previous month's circulation, percentage difference, the corresponding month of the previous year, and percentage difference between the prior month and prior year's month."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C118",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "Canned Report Extension",
   "description": "Authorized users must be able to add more canned reports according to permission level and edit canned-report display fields, such as adding shelving location."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C119",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "Report Queue Prioritization",
   "description": "The system must allow certain report types to be prioritized above resource-consuming reports in the execution queue."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C120",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "Item Usage Reporting",
   "description": "The system must provide total item-use counts and usage counts broken down by date ranges such as fiscal year or month."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C121",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "Detailed Circulation Totals",
   "description": "The system must retrieve total circulation including checkouts, renewals, and non-cataloged circulation and display a breakdown by circulation type."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C122",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "File-Based Report Filtering",
   "description": "Users must be able to upload a text file containing values such as barcodes or TCNs and use those values to filter a report."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C123",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "Notice Activity Reports",
   "description": "The system must support reports on pre-overdue notices, overdue notices, and holds notices sent."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C124",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "Pivot Table Output",
   "description": "The reporting system must provide pivot-table output."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C125",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "Report Output Validation",
   "description": "Report output must be tested and proven accurate for its intended reporting purpose."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C126",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "Report Cancellation",
   "description": "Users must be able to cancel a report that is scheduled to run or is currently running."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C127",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "Include Null Fields",
   "description": "Report results must include all null and blank fields regardless of the selected filtering or display criteria."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C128",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "Real-Time Reporting",
   "description": "The system must support real-time reporting."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C129",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "Historical Reporting Warehouse",
   "description": "The system must support historical reporting through a reporting warehouse that can provide data for a specified date or date range."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C130",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "Explicit Selection Criteria",
   "description": "The reporting interface must clearly define the selection criteria used for a report."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C131",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "Report Date Metadata",
   "description": "Report results must display the selected date criteria and report name at the top or bottom of the results."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C132",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "Survey Name Filtering",
   "description": "Users must be able to select a survey by survey name rather than entering its survey ID when filtering reports."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C133",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "Last-Copy Deletion Reports",
   "description": "The system must provide reports identifying deleted items that were the last copy owned by a library system or facility, supporting WorldCat updates."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C134",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "Single-Row MARC Fields",
   "description": "The system must be able to extract MARC record fields so that they appear on a single row of report data."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C135",
   "source_doc_id": "D10",
   "name": "Workstation Transaction Reports",
   "description": "The system must support reports for transactions occurring on a specified date and time, workstation, or staff member."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C136",
   "source_doc_id": "D11",
   "name": "Generate Item Value Reports",
   "description": "The system must generate reports showing the value of items based on item-record data, including the purchase price, for the entire collection or a selected portion such as all items with status "longoverdue" or all DVDs in the children's collection."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C137",
   "source_doc_id": "D11",
   "name": "Report Patron Account Balances",
   "description": "The system must provide financial reports of patron account balances by individual patron, home library, and the overall system."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C138",
   "source_doc_id": "D11",
   "name": "Report Accrued Fines Charges",
   "description": "The system must provide reports of fines and charges accrued during selectable time periods, including the last 12 months, year to date, and last month, and by charge type such as overdue fines, damaged-item charges, and lost-item charges."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C139",
   "source_doc_id": "D11",
   "name": "Report Waived Fines",
   "description": "The system must provide reports of fines waived by selectable time period and by branch or library, so each library can track waivers against its own budget."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C140",
   "source_doc_id": "D11",
   "name": "Report Payment Transactions",
   "description": "The system must provide reports of payments made during selectable time periods and by payment method, including staff desk, self-check station, OPAC, cash, credit card, and check, with payments also tracked by the library where they were collected."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C141",
   "source_doc_id": "D11",
   "name": "Query High-Balance Accounts",
   "description": "The system must allow staff to query patron accounts whose balances are greater than a user-specified dollar amount, so accounts needing attention can be identified efficiently."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C142",
   "source_doc_id": "D11",
   "name": "Join Financial Data Sources",
   "description": "The system must support financial-report queries that join financial data attached to patron records with financial data attached to item records."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C143",
   "source_doc_id": "D11",
   "name": "Update Financial Information Immediately",
   "description": "The system must allow financial information to be updated easily and must reflect a patron payment at the front desk immediately in the relevant financial records."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C144",
   "source_doc_id": "D11",
   "name": "Maintain Payment Audit Ledger",
   "description": "The system must maintain a ledger of patron payments that identifies the specific charges to which each payment was applied, enabling finance staff to trace payments and reconcile accounts."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C145",
   "source_doc_id": "D11",
   "name": "Meet Financial Compliance Requirements",
   "description": "The system's financial reports and data archiving must comply with standard accounting practice and state, county, and municipal auditing requirements."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C146",
   "source_doc_id": "D11",
   "name": "Enforce Data Retention Policies",
   "description": "The system must enforce data-archiving retention policies, including retaining data required for audit purposes for seven years where applicable under state and local requirements."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C147",
   "source_doc_id": "D12",
   "name": "Design Queries Across Records",
   "description": "The system must provide a user-friendly query-design interface that works against all record types and lets staff select query fields, choose values from picklists, select regular expressions from a dropdown, and use Boolean operators."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C148",
   "source_doc_id": "D12",
   "name": "Manage Report Templates",
   "description": "The system must let administrators create report templates that are available to staff, can be run as-is or modified, and preserve consistent results when modified. Administrators must be able to restrict which filters and display fields staff may alter, such as allowing a call-number range or display-field changes while preventing display of deleted items."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C149",
   "source_doc_id": "D12",
   "name": "Clone Report Templates",
   "description": "The system must let authorized users clone an existing report or template to create a separate new report variant rather than modifying the original template."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C150",
   "source_doc_id": "D12",
   "name": "Authorize Report Creation",
   "description": "The system must provide distinct, fine-grained permissions that control which users may create and clone reports."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C151",
   "source_doc_id": "D12",
   "name": "Control Shared Report Access",
   "description": "The system must let administrators create shared folders that allow or disallow staff from running specific reports and from running ad hoc reports against specific sets of data."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C152",
   "source_doc_id": "D12",
   "name": "Synchronize Role Permissions",
   "description": "The system must administer report permissions through roles so that changing a user's role, such as from Staff to Manager, automatically updates that user's report permissions."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C153",
   "source_doc_id": "D12",
   "name": "Provide Board Reports",
   "description": "The system must provide predefined reports for library boards containing basic statistics required for the Georgia Annual Report and activity measures for traffic and usage, including checkouts, check-ins, holds placed, and holds filled. The reports must support cross-tabulation by terminal, branch, system, hour, age range, patron type, and patron location."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C154",
   "source_doc_id": "D12",
   "name": "Archive Private Transactions",
   "description": "The system must retain transaction data for the period required by State law, identified as X years, while protecting patron privacy by excluding personally identifiable information and still providing useful demographic statistics."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C155",
   "source_doc_id": "D12",
   "name": "Show Query Selections",
   "description": "The system must provide the query selections or criteria together with the corresponding query results."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C156",
   "source_doc_id": "D12",
   "name": "Display Report Queue Status",
   "description": "The system must show staff whether their submitted report is in the queue, how many reports are ahead of it, when it was submitted, and its status as waiting, running, completed, or failed."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C157",
   "source_doc_id": "D12",
   "name": "Prioritize Reports",
   "description": "The system must allow designated important reports, such as a director's board report, to be prioritized so they can move ahead of lower-priority staff ad hoc queries in the report queue."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C158",
   "source_doc_id": "D13",
   "name": "Support Dual Staff Login",
   "description": "The system must support staff authentication through either an optional streamlined method, such as swiping an employee ID badge, or traditional individual username-and-password login. The streamlined method must be available but must not be required, so branches without card-reader infrastructure can continue using traditional login, and using a card must not bypass individual authentication."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C159",
   "source_doc_id": "D13",
   "name": "Track Logged-In Staff",
   "description": "The system must identify and track which individual staff member is logged in, regardless of whether authentication uses a card swipe or username and password, so staff activity can be audited."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C160",
   "source_doc_id": "D13",
   "name": "Control Access By Roles",
   "description": "The system must control user rights and privileges through assigned security groups or roles for individual staff members, workgroups, and arbitrary staff groups. It must support role-based access such as front desk staff having access to basic reports with limited filters, department heads being able to create and modify templates, and system administrators having full access to reports and permissions."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C161",
   "source_doc_id": "D13",
   "name": "Administer Security Roles",
   "description": "Administrators must be able to create and manage security groups and roles and assign them to staff members. Changing a staff member's permissions must be achievable by changing the person's role assignment rather than modifying individual permissions."
  },
  {

  },
  {
   "ref": "C163",
   "source_doc_id": "D14",
   "name": "Circulation By Dewey",

  },
  {

  },
  {

   "source_doc_id": "D14",
   "name": "Items Edited Count",

  },
  {
   "ref": "C168",
   "source_doc_id": "D14",

  },
  {
   "ref": "C169",
   "source_doc_id": "D14",

  },
  {
   "ref": "C170",
   "source_doc_id": "D14",
   "name": "Items By Total Use",
   "description": "The reporting system must list items having a specified total use count."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C171",
   "source_doc_id": "D14",
   "name": "Last Copy Report",

  },
  {

   "source_doc_id": "D14",
   "name": "Items By Creation Date",

  },
  {

   "source_doc_id": "D14",

  {

   "source_doc_id": "D14",

  {

  },
  {
   "ref": "C176",
   "source_doc_id": "D14",
   "name": "Collection Value By Call",

  },
  {
   "ref": "C177",
   "source_doc_id": "D14",

  },
  {

   "source_doc_id": "D14",

   "source_doc_id": "D14",
   "name": "Stale Holds Report",
   "description": "The reporting system must report stale holds."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C189",
   "source_doc_id": "D14",
   "name": "Detailed Aged Debt",
   "description": "The reporting system must provide an enhanced aged-debt report with detailed debt information."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C190",
   "source_doc_id": "D14",
   "name": "Report Queue Visibility",
   "description": "The reporting system must show staff the queue position and status of their reports, including reports awaiting processing and reports running in the background."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C191",
   "source_doc_id": "D14",
   "name": "Report Prioritization",
   "description": "The reporting system must allow authorized users to prioritize selected types of reports."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C192",
   "source_doc_id": "D14",
   "name": "Cancel Running Reports",
   "description": "The reporting system must allow authorized users to cancel a report that is running."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C193",
   "source_doc_id": "D14",
   "name": "Pivot Table Output",
   "description": "The reporting system must generate report results in pivot-table format."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C194",
   "source_doc_id": "D14",
   "name": "Real-Time Reporting",
   "description": "The reporting system must provide reports using current data in real time rather than only through non-real-time report execution."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C195",
   "source_doc_id": "D14",
   "name": "Historical Reporting Warehouse",
   "description": "The reporting system must provide a historical reporting warehouse that supports reporting on data from prior periods."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C196",
   "source_doc_id": "D14",
   "name": "Report Scheduling Modes",
   "description": "The reporting system must support report execution choices of Run ASAP, hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly, including the ability to select multiple reports to run at the same time."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C197",
   "source_doc_id": "D14",
   "name": "Report Email Delivery",
   "description": "The reporting system must deliver generated reports by email."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C198",
   "source_doc_id": "D14",
   "name": "Report Delivery Address Book",
   "description": "The reporting system must provide an address book for selecting report delivery recipients."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C199",
   "source_doc_id": "D14",
   "name": "Text File Filtering",
   "description": "The reporting system must allow users to upload text files containing values such as barcodes or TCNs for use as report filtering criteria."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C200",
   "source_doc_id": "D14",
   "name": "Selection Criteria Results",
   "description": "The reporting system must display the selection criteria used to produce report results."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C201",
   "source_doc_id": "D14",
   "name": "Canned Report Options",
   "description": "The reporting system must allow users to edit the display options of canned reports."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C202",
   "source_doc_id": "D14",
   "name": "Quick Report Access",
   "description": "The reporting system must provide a quick-access interface for reports with pop-up descriptions."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C203",
   "source_doc_id": "D14",
   "name": "Report Title Tooltips",
   "description": "The reporting system must provide hover tooltips for report titles."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C204",
   "source_doc_id": "D14",
   "name": "Reporting Database Replica",
   "description": "The reporting system must use a separate reporting database or replica so reporting operations are separated from the production database."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C205",
   "source_doc_id": "D14",
   "name": "Background Report Processing",
   "description": "The reporting system must process long-running reports in the background without requiring them to run interactively against the production operations."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C206",
   "source_doc_id": "D14",
   "name": "Report Template Management",
   "description": "The reporting system must provide management of report templates, including creating, maintaining, and reusing report definitions."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C207",
   "source_doc_id": "D14",
   "name": "Fine-Grained Report Permissions",
   "description": "The reporting system must provide fine-grained permissions controlling who can create and run reports, which reports staff can access, and which filters they can use."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C208",
   "source_doc_id": "D14",
   "name": "Environment Separation",
   "description": "The product must provide separate development and training environments for the reporting system."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C209",
   "source_doc_id": "D14",
   "name": "Configuration Migration",
   "description": "The reporting system must support migration of configuration between environments."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C210",
   "source_doc_id": "D14",
   "name": "Accessible Report Interface",
   "description": "The reporting interface must support accessibility compliance."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C211",
   "source_doc_id": "D14",
   "name": "Integrated Report Help",
   "description": "The reporting system must provide an online help system integrated with the report interface."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C212",
   "source_doc_id": "D14",
   "name": "On-Demand Reporting Interface",
   "description": "The reporting system must provide an on-demand reporting interface in addition to canned reports."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C213",
   "source_doc_id": "D14",
   "name": "Open Template Reporting",
   "description": "The reporting system must provide an open-template reporting interface that allows staff to create reports from report templates beyond the basic canned-report interface."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C214",
   "source_doc_id": "D14",
   "name": "Historical Bills Snapshot",
   "description": "The reporting system must provide a bills report that can show a snapshot of bills as they existed at a prior point in time."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C215",
   "source_doc_id": "D14",
   "name": "Distinct Last Edit Date",
   "description": "The reporting system must report the last edit date for a record without treating the last circulation event as the record's last edit."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C216",
   "source_doc_id": "D14",
   "name": "Last Circulation Date",
   "description": "The reporting system must expose the date of last circulation as a separate reportable field."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C217",
   "source_doc_id": "D14",
   "name": "Checkin Date Excluding Renewals",
   "description": "The reporting system must provide check-in date and time separately from renewal timestamps, without combining check-ins and renewals into one timestamp field."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C218",
   "source_doc_id": "D14",
   "name": "Include Null And Blank Fields",
   "description": "The reporting system must include records whose selected report fields are null or blank in report results rather than filtering them out."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C219",
   "source_doc_id": "D15",
   "name": "Track Uncataloged Inventory",
   "description": "The system must track shipments of paperback books, children's board books, and other material as inventory before individual catalog records are complete, while supporting rapid distribution with minimal branch labor."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C220",
   "source_doc_id": "D15",
   "name": "Measure Uncataloged Material Use",
   "description": "The system must identify how uncataloged material is being used and include transactions for that material in circulation statistics and reports."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C221",
   "source_doc_id": "D15",
   "name": "Query Transfer Candidates",
   "description": "The item transfer utility must query for candidate materials, such as children's-section items that have not circulated in six months, for possible movement between branches or collections."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C222",
   "source_doc_id": "D15",
   "name": "Save Transfer Queries",
   "description": "The item transfer utility must save candidate-material queries for repeated use, including monthly transfer workflows."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C223",
   "source_doc_id": "D15",
   "name": "Select Transfer Items",
   "description": "The item transfer utility must allow staff to manually select individual titles from query results when a more targeted transfer is needed."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C224",
   "source_doc_id": "D15",
   "name": "Change Item Locations",
   "description": "The item transfer utility must change the location records of selected items when they are moved to another branch, mobile library unit, outreach program collection, or other destination."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C225",
   "source_doc_id": "D15",
   "name": "Revert Item Locations",
   "description": "The item transfer utility must provide a mechanism to return transferred items to their original locations after a defined period, such as when a mobile library returns to its base."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C226",
   "source_doc_id": "D15",
   "name": "Report Missing Damaged Items",
   "description": "The system must provide a report showing all missing and damaged items by branch to support collection-health monitoring and identification of recurring location patterns."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C227",
   "source_doc_id": "D15",
   "name": "Report Delayed Transit Items",
   "description": "The system must provide one in-transit-items report that combines transit-to and transit-from items, identifies items in transit longer than a configurable number of days, and supports reporting by branch and by the entire system."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C228",
   "source_doc_id": "D15",
   "name": "Identify Purge Candidates",
   "description": "The system must provide weeding reports that identify items for purging using customizable criteria, including items in status "missing" for more than a specified number of months and items with status "discard/weed"."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C229",
   "source_doc_id": "D15",
   "name": "Batch Change Item Status",
   "description": "The system must support batch conversion of selected items from one status to another, including changing 100 items from "missing" to "discard/weed"."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C230",
   "source_doc_id": "D15",
   "name": "Report Last Copies",
   "description": "The system must provide a report identifying each library system's last copies so catalogers can check those copies before editing related WorldCat entries or otherwise risking deletion of a rare or unique copy."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C231",
   "source_doc_id": "D15",
   "name": "Delete Orphaned Catalog Records",
   "description": "The system must provide a quick method to delete volume entries together with their copy entries and to delete records that have no items attached, supporting cleanup of orphaned catalog records."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C232",
   "source_doc_id": "D15",
   "name": "Track Record Deletions",
   "description": "The system must count and track record deletions by location and by library system, including why each deletion occurred, so directors can audit deletions and staff can troubleshoot missing catalog content."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C233",
   "source_doc_id": "D15",
   "name": "Report Shelf Space Allocation",
   "description": "The system must provide a shelf-space report that compares, for each genre and format, the percentage of total circulations, percentage of the collection, and percentage of total shelf space to support resource-allocation decisions."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C234",
   "source_doc_id": "D15",
   "name": "Report Material Volumes",
   "description": "The system must provide a material-volume report covering acquisitions, items on shelf, and items in circulation, broken down by categories such as total items, holds, adult fiction, and board books."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C235",
   "source_doc_id": "D15",
   "name": "Report Data Quality Issues",
   "description": "The system must provide data-quality reports identifying items with invalid item types, items with excessively long call numbers, and bibliographic records with no item records."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C236",
   "source_doc_id": "D15",
   "name": "Display Item Edit Dates",
   "description": "Reports must display the last edit date for an item based on item edits only; the displayed date must not be updated by or include the item's last circulation."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C237",
   "source_doc_id": "D16",
   "name": "Cross-Platform Server Support",
   "description": "The reporting system must run on both Red Hat Enterprise Linux 5 and Solaris 10 on SPARC hardware so that it operates in the primary and disaster-recovery/reporting server environments."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C238",
   "source_doc_id": "D16",
   "name": "Non-Disruptive Report Processing",
   "description": "The system must process searches and reports during open hours without disrupting other system functions, including circulation-client operation and patron access to the OPAC. Complex reports must be capable of being queued and processed in the background or otherwise isolated through read-only reporting infrastructure."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C239",
   "source_doc_id": "D16",
   "name": "Legacy Browser Support",
   "description": "The system must support Microsoft Internet Explorer 6.0 and later and Firefox 2.0 and later so libraries using these browsers can access the reporting system."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C240",
   "source_doc_id": "D16",
   "name": "Section 508 Accessibility",
   "description": "The system must comply with Section 508 and support staff using screen readers such as JAWS and NVDA, screen-magnification software such as ZoomText, and other assistive technologies. Its HTML output must be standards-compliant, properly structured, and include alternative text, ARIA labels, and semantic HTML so blind and other disabled staff can run reports."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C241",
   "source_doc_id": "D16",
   "name": "Relational Database Integration",
   "description": "The reporting system must work with the existing PostgreSQL 8.3 relational database structure, support complex joins, and use the main relational database rather than requiring a denormalized reporting schema that can create synchronization issues."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C242",
   "source_doc_id": "D16",
   "name": "Role-Based Access Control",
   "description": "The system must control permissions through security groups and/or roles that can be assigned to individuals, workgroups, and arbitrary staff groups. It must support the access levels Patron, Staff, Local Admin, and Global Admin, and changing a user's permissions must be achievable by changing the user's role assignment. Role administration must be straightforward for administrators."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C243",
   "source_doc_id": "D16",
   "name": "Separate Operating Environments",
   "description": "The product must provide separate development, production, and training environments so developers can test new reports without affecting production and new staff can practice running reports without risking operational mistakes."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C244",
   "source_doc_id": "D16",
   "name": "Configuration Migration",
   "description": "The system must provide export and import functionality to migrate configurations developed in development or training into production, including report templates, permission settings, and other configuration."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C245",
   "source_doc_id": "D16",
   "name": "OPAC Performance Isolation",
   "description": "The management reporting system must not constrain or slow the OPAC; patrons must retain fast, responsive catalog access even when the reporting system performs a large query."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C246",
   "source_doc_id": "D16",
   "name": "Searchable Online Help",
   "description": "The system must provide online HTML help for staff that is hierarchical, cross-linked, searchable, and easy to navigate, enabling staff to learn how to run reports without contacting IT for routine assistance."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C247",
   "source_doc_id": "D17",
   "name": "Analyze Collection Use",
   "description": "The management reporting functionality must enable library managers, administrators, and staff to analyze the library collection and how patrons use it for planning, evaluation, and oversight."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C248",
   "source_doc_id": "D17",
   "name": "Analyze Branch Capacity",
   "description": "The management reporting functionality must enable library managers, administrators, and staff to analyze branch capacity and determine the optimal distribution of the collection across branches for planning and oversight."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C249",
   "source_doc_id": "D17",
   "name": "Analyze Patron Demographics",
   "description": "The management reporting functionality must enable library managers, administrators, and staff to analyze patron demographics and interests to support planning and evaluation of library services."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C250",
   "source_doc_id": "D17",
   "name": "Analyze Staff Productivity",
   "description": "The management reporting functionality must enable library managers, administrators, and staff to analyze staff productivity and workflow for management oversight and service evaluation."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C251",
   "source_doc_id": "D17",
   "name": "Track Financial Transactions",
   "description": "The management reporting functionality must enable authorized library managers, administrators, and staff to track and verify financial transactions for management oversight."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C252",
   "source_doc_id": "D17",
   "name": "Provide Report Templates",
   "description": "The product must provide templates needed by all PINES libraries for their management reporting activities."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C253",
   "source_doc_id": "D18",
   "name": "Consortium Scale Support",
   "description": "The management processes must support a library consortium with 286 locations, 17 million annual circulations, and purchasing and processing over 900,000 items per year."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C254",
   "source_doc_id": "D18",
   "name": "Non-Disruptive Report Processing",
   "description": "Searches and reports must be processable during open hours without slowing or disrupting circulation and other system functions, including through background processing or queuing when needed."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C255",
   "source_doc_id": "D18",
   "name": "Cross-Branch Comparisons",
   "description": "The reporting functionality must provide reports that compare data across library branches or locations for library management."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C256",
   "source_doc_id": "D18",
   "name": "Report Queue Visibility",
   "description": "Authorized staff must be able to view the status and visibility of reports submitted for processing, so they can determine whether reports are queued, running, completed, or otherwise unavailable."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C257",
   "source_doc_id": "D18",
   "name": "Predefined Executive Reports",
   "description": "The system must provide predefined reports for board and executive reporting needs."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C258",
   "source_doc_id": "D18",
   "name": "Data Quality Reports",
   "description": "The reporting functionality must provide reports that identify or communicate data quality problems to staff."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C259",
   "source_doc_id": "D18",
   "name": "In-Transit Item Reports",
   "description": "The system must provide reports on items currently in transit between locations to support delivery coordination."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C260",
   "source_doc_id": "D18",
   "name": "Branch Missing Damage Reports",
   "description": "The system must provide missing-item and damaged-item reports for individual branches."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C261",
   "source_doc_id": "D18",
   "name": "Weeding Reports",
   "description": "The system must provide reports to support collection weeding activities."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C262",
   "source_doc_id": "D18",
   "name": "Shelf Space Utilization",
   "description": "The system must provide reports showing shelf space utilization to support branch and collection management."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C263",
   "source_doc_id": "D18",
   "name": "Demographic Analysis Reports",
   "description": "The system must provide demographic analysis reports for library program planning."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C264",
   "source_doc_id": "D18",
   "name": "Linux Solaris Operation",
   "description": "The management processes must operate on a Linux or Solaris server."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C265",
   "source_doc_id": "D18",
   "name": "Browser Client Access",
   "description": "The management processes must be accessible through a web browser or a Windows-compatible client."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C266",
   "source_doc_id": "D18",
   "name": "Supported Web Browsers",
   "description": "When accessed through a web browser, the management processes must support Microsoft Internet Explorer version 6.0 and later and Mozilla Firefox version 2.0 and later."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C267",
   "source_doc_id": "D18",
   "name": "Assistive Technology Access",
   "description": "The management processes must be accessible using screen-reading software, screen-magnification software, and other accessibility software, including JAWS, NVDA, and ZoomText, and must satisfy Section 508 accessibility requirements."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C268",
   "source_doc_id": "D18",
   "name": "Relational Database Backend",
   "description": "The management processes must use a fully relational database back end and work with the relational data structure used for reporting."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C269",
   "source_doc_id": "D18",
   "name": "Standards-Compliant HTML",
   "description": "The system must produce valid, standards-compliant HTML for report displays, the help system, and web-based user-interface components."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C270",
   "source_doc_id": "D18",
   "name": "Development Training Environment",
   "description": "The system must provide separate development and training environments in which configurations, including report templates and other report configurations, can be migrated to a production environment through export and import or equivalent migration capability."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C271",
   "source_doc_id": "D18",
   "name": "Role-Based Access Control",
   "description": "The system must control user rights and privileges through security groups or roles that support access control for individual users, workgroups, and arbitrary staff groups."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C272",
   "source_doc_id": "D18",
   "name": "OPAC Function Preservation",
   "description": "Management-process requirements and functionality must not constrain or adversely affect the functionality or features of the Online Public Access Catalog."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C273",
   "source_doc_id": "D18",
   "name": "Record Data Specifications",
   "description": "The product must provide complete data specifications for authority, bibliographic, order, item, hold/request, and other records maintained or accessed by the management processes, enabling staff to understand the data structures used for queries."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C274",
   "source_doc_id": "D18",
   "name": "Process Documentation",
   "description": "The product documentation must provide thorough high-level descriptions of major processes, including bibliographic record import and export, validation of bibliographic records against internal and external authority sources, and standard reports."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C275",
   "source_doc_id": "D18",
   "name": "Online Cross-Linked Help",
   "description": "The system must provide an online, hierarchical, cross-linked HTML help system that describes and illustrates all system functions and is available without requiring staff to leave the system."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C276",
   "source_doc_id": "D18",
   "name": "Meaningful Error Feedback",
   "description": "The system must provide thorough high-level error reporting and feedback when operations or reports fail, and must provide low-level query-specific feedback through the front-end interface to Local and Global System Administrators."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C277",
   "source_doc_id": "D18",
   "name": "Enterprise ILS Integration",
   "description": "The management processes must use the data structures and functionality of an enterprise-level Library Automation System, including its Acquisitions and Cataloging modules, rather than independently managing those functions."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C278",
   "source_doc_id": "D18",
   "name": "Vendor Data Integration",
   "description": "The management processes must interface with vendor websites through published APIs and/or automated transfers of standard-format data files, including formats such as USMARC21 and EDIFACT, so reporting can use data from external sources."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C279",
   "source_doc_id": "D18",
   "name": "OPAC Data Access",
   "description": "The management processes must interact with the Online Public Access Catalog and query patron data created there, including holds and circulation data."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C280",
   "source_doc_id": "D19",
   "name": "Relational Database Backend",
   "description": "The Management Processes reporting system must use a fully relational database backend and operate with the relational data structure rather than relying on denormalization or a separate reporting warehouse synchronized with the live database."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C281",
   "source_doc_id": "D19",
   "name": "Standards-Compliant HTML",
   "description": "The web interface, help system, and report output must produce HTML that validates against W3C standards to support compatibility with different browsers and assistive technologies."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C282",
   "source_doc_id": "D19",
   "name": "Environment Configuration Migration",
   "description": "The system must support separate development, training, and production environments and allow administrators to export and import templates, permission settings, and saved queries between those environments."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C283",
   "source_doc_id": "D19",
   "name": "Safe Training Environment",
   "description": "The training environment must allow staff to experiment without risking production data."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C284",
   "source_doc_id": "D19",
   "name": "Role-Based Access Control",
   "description": "The system must provide security groups or roles that control access for individuals, workgroups, and arbitrary staff groups, with permission changes managed by changing role assignments. It must support Global Admin full system access, Local Admin branch-level reporting and configuration, Library Manager execution of approved reports with limited template modification, Staff execution of reports within assigned permissions, and indirect Patron access through OPAC displays."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C285",
   "source_doc_id": "D19",
   "name": "OPAC Performance Isolation",
   "description": "The management reporting system must remain separate from the public catalog so that running a report does not slow down the OPAC."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C286",
   "source_doc_id": "D19",
   "name": "Complete Data Specifications",
   "description": "The product must provide complete data specifications and data dictionaries for authority, bibliographic, order, item, hold/request, and other records maintained or accessed by Management Processes, including field names, data types, and relationships so staff can write effective queries."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C287",
   "source_doc_id": "D19",
   "name": "Process Documentation",
   "description": "The product must provide thorough high-level descriptions of major processes, including bibliographic record import and export, validation of bibliographic records against internal and external authority sources, and standard reports."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C288",
   "source_doc_id": "D19",
   "name": "Accessible Online Help",
   "description": "The system must provide an online help system in HTML that is hierarchical, cross-linked, and accessible to users of screen readers."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C289",
   "source_doc_id": "D19",
   "name": "Detailed Error Reporting",
   "description": "The system must provide thorough high-level error reporting and feedback, plus low-level query-specific feedback for administrators. Failed reports must identify relevant details such as the table, field, and type of error rather than only returning a generic failure message."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C290",
   "source_doc_id": "D19",
   "name": "Centralized Multi-Location Service",
   "description": "Management Processes must be consolidated at a central location that accepts input from and provides services to multiple library locations, supporting a single source of truth for reporting."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C291",
   "source_doc_id": "D19",

   "description": "Management Processes must rely on and read the data structures and functionality of the enterprise-level Library Automation System, including its Acquisitions and Cataloging modules, without managing acquisitions or cataloging data."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C292",
   "source_doc_id": "D19",
   "name": "Vendor Data Integration",
   "description": "Management Processes must interface with vendor websites through published APIs and/or automated transfers of standard-format data files, including formats such as USMARC21 and EDIFACT, while accommodating libraries where particular vendor data is unavailable."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C293",
   "source_doc_id": "D19",

  },
  {
   "ref": "C294",
   "source_doc_id": "D19",
   "name": "Report Output Formats",
   "description": "The reporting system must produce reports in Excel, HTML, and CSV formats to support web display, business-user pivot-table work, and reliable data export."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C295",
   "source_doc_id": "D19",
   "name": "Real-Time Historical Reporting",
   "description": "The reporting system must support reports using current real-time data, such as items overdue today, and reports using historical data, such as the bill amount on a specified past date."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C296",
   "source_doc_id": "D19",
   "name": "Report Cancellation",
   "description": "The system must allow users to cancel scheduled or currently running reports, including while report processing is underway."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C297",
   "source_doc_id": "D19",
   "name": "Complete Null Results",
   "description": "Reports and data exports must include records containing null values or blank fields rather than excluding those results."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C298",
   "source_doc_id": "D19",
   "name": "Survey Name Filtering",
   "description": "The reporting system must allow users to filter by survey name and must resolve the supplied survey name to the corresponding survey ID internally."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C299",
   "source_doc_id": "D20",
   "name": "Retain Transaction History",
   "description": "The system must retain transaction history for a configurable number of days and retain monthly and annual aggregates indefinitely."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C300",
   "source_doc_id": "D20",
   "name": "Group Transactions By Dimensions",

  },
  {
   "ref": "C301",
   "source_doc_id": "D20",

  },
  {
   "ref": "C302",
   "source_doc_id": "D20",
   "name": "Count Check-Out Types",

  },
  {
   "ref": "C303",
   "source_doc_id": "D20",

  },
  {
   "ref": "C304",
   "source_doc_id": "D20",

  {
   "ref": "C305",
   "source_doc_id": "D20",

  {

   "source_doc_id": "D20",

  {

   "source_doc_id": "D20",

  },
  {

   "source_doc_id": "D20",

  {
   "ref": "C309",
   "source_doc_id": "D20",

  },
  {
   "ref": "C310",
   "source_doc_id": "D20",
   "name": "Show Report Queue Position",

  {
   "ref": "C311",
   "source_doc_id": "D20",
   "name": "Save And Reuse Queries",
   "description": "Users must be able to save queries and reuse them for repeated reporting tasks."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C312",
   "source_doc_id": "D20",
   "name": "Export Multiple Report Formats",
   "description": "The system must provide report output in Excel, CSV, HTML, and pivot-table formats."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C313",
   "source_doc_id": "D20",
   "name": "Deliver Reports By Email",
   "description": "The system must be able to deliver completed reports by email."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C314",
   "source_doc_id": "D20",
   "name": "Schedule Recurring Reports",
   "description": "Users must be able to schedule reports to run repeatedly on a recurring basis."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C315",
   "source_doc_id": "D20",
   "name": "Cancel Report Execution",
   "description": "Users must be able to cancel a scheduled report or a report that is currently running."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C316",
   "source_doc_id": "D20",
   "name": "Provide Historical Reporting",

  },
  {
   "ref": "C317",
   "source_doc_id": "D20",
   "name": "Provide Real-Time Reports",
   "description": "The system must provide real-time reporting for monitoring busy periods."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C318",
   "source_doc_id": "D20",
   "name": "Include Empty Report Values",
   "description": "Report results must include null and blank field values rather than omitting records or fields containing them."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C319",
   "source_doc_id": "D20",
   "name": "Prevent Duplicate Export Rows",
   "description": "Report exports, including Excel exports, must avoid unintended duplicate rows so that the exported data can be used without repeated records."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C320",
   "source_doc_id": "D20",
   "name": "Select MARC Fields Across Rows",
   "description": "The system must allow reports to retrieve specific MARC fields even when those fields are stored across multiple rows."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C321",
   "source_doc_id": "D20",
   "name": "Query Candidate Materials",
   "description": "The system must allow users to query for materials that are candidates for administrative actions such as collection review or related material processing."
  },
  {

   "source_doc_id": "D20",
   "name": "Select Query Results Manually",
   "description": "Users must be able to manually select individual records from query results for subsequent administrative processing."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C323",
   "source_doc_id": "D20",
   "name": "Move Items Between Locations",
   "description": "The system must allow authorized users to change item records to move items to a new location."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C324",
   "source_doc_id": "D20",
   "name": "Revert Item Locations",
   "description": "The system must allow authorized users to revert items to their original locations."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C325",
   "source_doc_id": "D20",
   "name": "Track Record Deletions",
   "description": "The system must count and track record deletions."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C326",
   "source_doc_id": "D20",
   "name": "Show Last Item Circulation",
   "description": "Item reports must be able to indicate the last circulation date for each item."
  },
  {
   "ref": "C327",
   "source_doc_id": "D20",
   "name": "Exclude Renewals From Check-In",
   "description": "Check-in date and time reporting must exclude renewal transactions so that renewal activity is not counted as check-in activity."
